en: Vintage black-and-white image showing a crowded outdoor café terrace under large leafy trees. Many well‑dressed people in early 20th‑century clothing sit at metal tables and folding chairs, socializing and drinking. A pavilion or café building is visible in the background. Printed red text along the bottom reads the name of the café, the park, the city, and the photographer/publisher.
